verdict.rationale: Muse documents "side chats" so users can keep separate context for certain topics as projects grow more complex. That is a thin analogue to topic-scoped context, not a project or space container. Files live in the agent's VM, but nothing shows them being grouped with chats under a shared project. missing for 10: an explicit project/space container grouping chats and files, per-project shared instructions, documentation of how side-chat context is shared or scoped, independent or hands-on corroboration.
